name: local-community-event-planning-platform
description: Local Community Event Planning Platform - Vite + React frontend, Node.js/Express API, Microsoft Azure (App Service, Azure SQL Database, Blob Storage)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:reset --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
